content: Happy Thanksgiving! As expected, it’s a big one for movies. Disney’s latest, Hexed, is out in theaters. There’s also Focker-In-Law, the newest addition to the Meet the Parents franchise. The most intriguing film this weekend, though, is The Further Misadventures of Cliff Booth, which finds Quentin Tarantino continuing the story of Brad Pitt’s character from Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood through David Fincher’s lens. It at least has to be an interesting experiment in different cinematic styles.
